# min

> min is IRL activity on demand: a few concrete things to do nearby, right now, alone or with people. Tap once, prepay the coffee or the ticket, and go. No feed, no swiping, no chat. Launching for Helsinki-area students in early 2027.

## Key facts

- What it is: open min and see live offers close by that you can go to right now. Join one in a tap or tell min what you're up for, prepay the activity item, and go. Alone, with a friend, or with people nearby who share an interest.
- Not a dating app: min finds you something to do nearby, alone or with people who share an interest. The activity is the point. What happens after it is up to you.
- Strangers are optional: go alone, bring a friend, or join people nearby who are up for the same thing. Solo activities skip the wait entirely.
- How it differs from Meetup or event apps: events are planned days or weeks ahead. min is for the free hour you have right now: live offers close by that you can go to straight away, with the time, place and payment already sorted in one tap.
- Price: using min is free, with no subscription. When you join an activity you prepay its item, like the coffee or the museum ticket, plus a small service fee. You see the full price before you accept, and if a group doesn't fill in time you get your money back.
- Privacy: min knows what you tell it in short chats and which activities you go to, so the offers fit you better. You can see, correct or delete it at any time. We don't sell your data, and min is built for GDPR from day one.
- Safety: activities happen in public venues, never anyone's home. min is 18+, with your date of birth confirmed at signup. Others only see a nickname, avatar, short intro and age range. You can cancel up to the meeting with a neutral "plans changed", and block or report in one tap. Every report is reviewed by a person within 24 hours.
- Where and when: Helsinki area first (Aalto University, Arcada, Diak, Haaga-Helia, Hanken, Humak, Laurea, Metropolia, Uniarts, University of Helsinki and more), including international and exchange students. Early 2027.
- Contact: hello@hellomin.app
